ABI and consumer-side helpers for reading high-frequency QUIC logs from shared memory.

# Purpose
`fd_quic_log_user.h` defines the consumer-side ABI for reading high-frequency logs from an `fd_quic` instance. It declares the `fd_quic_log_rx_t` join state, the shared-memory layout constants `FD_QUIC_LOG_ALIGN` and `FD_QUIC_LOG_MAGIC`, and the join and leave functions [`fd_quic_log_rx_join`](<#fd_quic_log_rx_join>) and [`fd_quic_log_rx_leave`](<#fd_quic_log_rx_leave>). The file also provides small inline helpers to convert a chunk to a local address with [`fd_quic_log_rx_data_const`](<#fd_quic_log_rx_data_const>), check read bounds with [`fd_quic_log_rx_is_safe`](<#fd_quic_log_rx_is_safe>), extract an event ID from a `sig` field with [`fd_quic_log_sig_event`](<#fd_quic_log_sig_event>), and read the most recent metadata entry with [`fd_quic_log_rx_tail`](<#fd_quic_log_rx_tail>). It does not define any log write API; that part is kept in `fd_quic_log_internal.h`.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_quic_log_rx_join`
- `fd_quic_log_rx_leave`
